name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: A fully styled select with a popover list, built on the browser's customizable <select>. Other browsers show a regular styled select.

classes.name: combobox
classes.description: Use it on a <select>, together with input.

variables.name: --combobox-max-block-size
variables.description: Maximum height of the list before it scrolls.

notes: This uses appearance: base-select, the customizable <select>. In browsers that do not support it yet, the same markup is a regular select with velle's input styling, so forms keep working everywhere.
Options can contain icons and other markup. Add <button><selectedcontent></selectedcontent></button> as the first child of the select to show the chosen option's markup in the field.

Being a real <select>, it supports keyboard navigation and typing the first letters of an option, and it submits like any select. It does not offer free-text search, creating new values or loading options from a server; css-zero used tom-select for those.
Without JavaScript and without a dependency, this replaces css-zero's tom-select based combobox.
